observations.text: Original AC L browser median0.39291947->0.47515337cores(+20.9289%). All3 paired deltas are positive; most is renderer+GPU process CPU, not browser main or backend.

Original baseline b0 has30->30 GPU geometries and calls p50=426; b1 has51->32 and p50=439; b2 has51->51 and p50=448. Candidate has51->51 and p50=448 in all3. Canonical50/1500 and visible8/270 remain equal. Original actual render work/cold finite resource state is not identical despite formal settings validity.

AC b2 draw-call and triangle distributions match (apart from frame count) with51geometries each, but browser CPU remains+0.01836386cores(+4.0202%), renderer+0.01550803, GPU process+0.00285555. JS submit p50 is2.4->2.6ms. Original fleet poses differ slightly, so this is closer-matched rather than every-frame identical work.

Separate battery pairs show+0.00246661cores(+0.6297%) and+0.00612879(+1.5891%). Within each pair camera/preferences/DPR/canonical/visible/initial fleet pose match; calls/triangles distributions match;52GPU geometries and31lines occur in both phases. End fleet differs slightly with finite elapsed/frame-count differences.

Both frozen context implementations poll metrics every15000ms. All L runs record one live interval and2->6interval callbacks,0steady WS messages,0parse/store callbacks,0longTasks; backend CPU stays about0.0013-0.0018cores. Current resetManagement/diagnose/scope/abort bootstrap is legitimate source work, but no recorded extra sustained network/diagnostic workload explains the AC CPU difference.

networkDiagnostic=false/network=null; React profiling disabled and summary.react={} / rawReactCommits0 do NOT establish zero React commits. No stack samples, CPU frequency/thermal/core-placement data, physical presented FPS or GPU utilization. No causal hardware/GC claim can be made.

Changed fault-caption position/style can do DOM/per-frame work when actual markers are mounted. measuredTraffic is null in all L runs; no recorded measured flow work explains the difference. Provider polling is gated by live/managementVisible/trafficEnabled/active and readonly scope. Aggregate containerFaults53 is not an active-marker count. No profile attributes residual CPU to captions, metrics, sessions or GC.

Lettering uses synchronous bundled TextGeometry/useMemo, so these sources do not support an asynchronous font-download explanation. Finite geometry/DOM/heap changes are observed; their exact object identities or cause were not recorded.

causalConclusion.description: The original AC observation is real but is not a clean21% same-work source-regression estimate. The later controlled battery protocol fails to reproduce that magnitude and shows only0.63-1.59% positive CPU differences. It cannot causally clear the original AC living residual because both power and setup changed, n=2 is small, and stack/hardware counters were not recorded.
causalConclusion.releaseGateRecommendation: DO_NOT_BLANKET_PASS_CPU_NO_UNEXPLAINED_MEANINGFUL_REGRESSION. Frame/canonical/process-coverage gates pass, but the AC CPU subgate retains an unexplained observation/residual. Root should retain stable BLOCKED/conditional status for that mandatory CPU claim rather than turn formal valid=true or battery n2 into universal clearance.
causalConclusion.nextDiagnosticQuestionOnly: If separately authorized later, compare CPU/JS stacks in the original AC living state with allocated/render workload truly matched (including geometry/marker state), then ask whether caption/layout/per-frame JS or native renderer/driver accounts for the residual. No further benchmark/profile was run in this review.

diagnosticRecommendation.recommendation: Two separately authorized short baseline/candidate CPU profiles could identify a large changed JavaScript call path and narrow the caption/DOM/per-frame hypothesis. They would be diagnostics only, not acceptance repeats or a statistical CPU comparison. No profile was run by this review.
diagnosticRecommendation.existingHarnessImplementation: benchmarks/run.mjs:1027 enables CDP Profiler and starts V8 CPU sampling; lines1217-1224 stop it and write a cpuprofile.
diagnosticRecommendation.coverageLimit: The page CDP V8 CPU profile is not a GPU-process/native renderer/driver/thread profiler. An empty or similar JS profile cannot clear the measured browser total or the GPU-process component. Profiling adds instrumentation overhead.
diagnosticRecommendation.ifLaterAuthorized: Use the original AC living state and match actual geometry/calls/triangles/camera/fleet/visible marker state before interpreting the two profiles. Keep their results separate from the 3-pair AC and 2-pair battery data. No further full matrix or soak is proposed.

faultMarkerHypothesisAddendum.method: Read-only frozen-source review plus pure CPU-side geometry construction from installed locked three; no test, browser, profiling, build, network or cluster action.

actualGeometryCalculation.rendererSource: WebGLRenderer.js:1349 handles geometry groups only when material is an array; scalar Lettering material submits one render item.

dom.interpretation: Whole-page DOM counts and document reclamation do not enumerate FaultMarker spans. They cannot prove eleven markers.

originAndSelectionPath: visualLifecycle.js:430-434 initializes every new container effect with origin:null; sampleContainerEffect at623-628 fills origin on the first sample, once.

HarborScene.jsx:914 samples effects during the PodCargo per-frame loop when a nonsettled effect exists and the cargo has a position; null fleet pose alone is not a permanent blocker because pose fields are optional and podVisual has fallback positions.
FaultMarker at LifecycleEffects.jsx:231 dynamically recomputes visible from effect.origin and phase on every frame; origin is not captured once in a React closure.

visibleContainerMarkers at visualLifecycle.js:25 filters visible UIDs, nonsettled phase and selection/age; HarborScene.jsx:1999 recomputes this list during React render. A different render/data scheduling history can plausibly change which marker children remain mounted, but direction and exact membership are not recorded.

HarborScene, visualLifecycle and fleet are byte-equal baseline/candidate. App/context changes can change scheduling, but existing evidence does not establish that candidate publishes caused eleven origins to be filled while baseline origins stayed null.
faultMarkerHypothesisAddendum.qualification: The exact22-draw/704-triangle footprint provides a concrete, source-backed explanation candidate for the extra actual visual work in ACb0. It is not a unique attribution: geometry-memory delta21 does not equal22 constructed geometries, aggregate fault count53 is not mounted/visible marker count, and no named scene/marker/origin inventory was recorded. Raw snapshots is only a numeric message count, not saved effect state. The geometry-memory counter measures renderer allocations, not component membership.
faultMarkerHypothesisAddendum.causalConclusion: SUPPORTED_FOOTPRINT_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY. Cannot prove source publish/origin timing cause, cannot quantify CPU from triangle/draw counts, and cannot clear ACb2 +4.02% residual with equal draw/triangle distributions. CPU gate remains BLOCKED.
